title: 情報工学基礎演習
subtitle: Computer Programming Practice
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn basic management and operational skills for computer systems. (2) Acquire various C programming skills on Linux command line. (3) Acquire Linux environment construction and operation technology.
advice: This is a basic C programming course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Installing virtual machines and Linux 2. Linux command exercises 3. Programming with the basic data types and array 4. Standard input/output stream 5. Programming with the function definitions and its calls 6. Recursive function call 7. Programming with the structure and pointer 8. String processing 9. File input/output processing 10. Programming with the bitwise logical operators Students are expected to bring their textbook, notebook PC, and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.
books: Textbooks:C language for beginners(ISBN 978-4-407-32089-3, Japaneses Version Only) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This course requires the following knowledge/skills: 1. The units of “Programming 1” and “Programming 2” have been acquired. 2. Knowledge of basic logical operation. 3. Basic computer programming skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to manage programming, debugging, and execution.
Be able to create a program with appropriate combinations of functions, pointers, structures, etc.
Be able to verify that the program is executing correctly.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to learn the following multiple elemental technologies required for C programming and create an advanced program on the Linux command line: 1. Basic data types 2. Array and Structure 3. String and Pointer 4. Function definition 5. File input/output processing 6. Recursive function call 7. Bitwise logical operator 8. Linux system call
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to learn the following multiple elemental technologies required for C programming and create a basic program on the Linux command line: 1. Basic data types 2. Array and Structure 3. String and Pointer 4. Function definition 5. File input/output processing 6. Recursive function call

lessons.content: ・Overview of Linux and C programming ・Install Linux on your own notebook PC, and learn the overview of C programming ・Text Capter 0
Text Chapter 1 "Basics of C Programming" 1 Constants 2 Variables 3 Data Types
Text Chapter 2 "Input/Output and Operators" 1 Output to the screen 2 Input from the keyboard 3 Operators
Text Chapter 3 "Processing Flow" 1 Expressions and Statements 2 Branching 3 Repetition
・Text Chapter 4 "Functions" 1 Functions 2 Function Declaration and Definition 3 Passing Values 4 Recursion
Text Chapter 5 "Memory Classes and Applicable Scope" 1 Memory Classes and Applicable Scope 2 Functions and Memory Classes
Text Chapter 6 "Arrays" 1 Concept of Arrays 2 One-dimensional Arrays 3 Two-dimensional Arrays 4 Arrays Passed to Functions
Text Chapter 7 "Pointers" 1 Basics of Pointer Variables 2 Use of Pointer Variables
Text Chapter 8 "Structures and Common Structures " 1 Structures 2 Common bodies (Omitted in this course)
Text Chapter 9 "File Processing" 1 Files 2 File Processing
Text Chapter 10 "Standard Functions" 1 Types of Standard Functions 2 Standard Functions
Chapter 11 "Preprocessor and Partitioned Compilation" 1 Preprocessor 2 Partitioned Compilation

    授業の概要および学習上の助言   This is a basic C programming course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Installing virtual machines and Linux 2. Linux command exercises 3. Programming with the basic data types and array 4. Standard input/output stream 5. Programming with the function definitions and its calls 6. Recursive function call 7. Programming with the structure and pointer 8. String processing 9. File input/output processing 10. Programming with the bitwise logical operators Students are expected to bring their textbook, notebook PC, and other necessary materials to every class.
